blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Maverick Ahanmisi will take everything into consideration before deciding his next route as he becomes a free agent following Terrafirma’s exit from the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Ahanmisi registered the first triple-double of his career with 18 points, 10 rebounds and 14 assists in Saturday’s 147-115 rout of Titan Ultra at Ynares Center here, a game that could be his last in a Dyip uniform. The veteran guard will be an unrestricted free agent in the offseason, meaning that he can entertain offers from any team without limitations. “Whatever God has planned on me,” Ahanmisi said when asked of his future.
